messages:
sam_sales: 10min before call with EU card issuer. They want a clear answer: for a hosted POC can we keep inference + logs in EU only? also need subprocessors and what happens when eu capacity is full.

claire_se: Short: hosted supports EU-preferring endpoints. For strict contractual EU-only processing we recommend Dedicated/Private. For POC we usually do hosted with region pin and tests.

igor_eng: Routing detail: we honor X-Region and routingStrict flag. Default behavior: prefer same-region -> compatible in-region variant -> if allowed, fallback to nearest region. routingStrict=true causes fail-open to 5xx instead of cross-region. Example header: `X-Region: eu-west-1` + `X-Routing-Strict: 1`.

hannah_legal: For questionnaire wording use: "Hosted EU-prefixed endpoints route and store request data in EU regions by default. Under capacity constraints, and unless strict routing is contracted, requests may fall back to other regions. Customers requiring contractual EU-only processing should choose Dedicated or Private deployments."

sam_sales: Do logs/telemetry ever go to US?

igor_eng: Raw request logs remain in-region. Aggregated telemetry may touch global services; we can exclude customer identifiers for POC. For full in-region logs + CMK, use Dedicated/Private.

claire_se: Subprocessor list can be shared under NDA. For POC we'll provide a sanitized list and an SOW paragraph describing routing and fallback.

sam_sales: Pricing quick note?

claire_se: Hosted EU pin = standard hosted pricing. Dedicated EU pool for guaranteed residency = reserved monthly commit, usually a single-month trial with a small uplift (~8-12%) for isolated capacity. Exact quote after QPS/token estimate.

ops-bot: Notification: eu-west-1 hosted pool scaled +3 nodes at 1769470500.

sam_sales: Action items: 1) claire to send sanitized subprocessors + SOW paragraph (ETA today 16:00 CET). 2) igor to prepare test steps to validate no-egress (ETA EOD). 3) claire to produce ballpark Dedicated 1-month uplift once customer QPS known.

claire_se: Ack, will send docs and curl examples.

igor_eng: Test steps quick: set headers, send test IDs, fetch request traces and bucket locations we provide. Also run a forced burst to confirm routingStrict behaviour.

sam_sales: Great, I'll update the customer after the call.
